author: terencechain
content:
Preregistration feels a little tricky, if a deposit doesn’t match an active preregistration, then eth is burned, but if there’s no preregistration, we accept but there's a front running attack vector here (once an attacker sees your pending preregistration, they can deposit first using your pub key and their withdrawal address, if you then deposit without double check, your deposit becomes a top up) so have we considered only allowing the first deposit for a new XMSS key once its preregistration is active? 

What about builders? since their deposit path doesn’t check preregistrations at all?

content: Does anyone know how proposer preferences work in PQ if deep reorg happens? Currently lodestar re-signs a proposer preferences whenever dependent root changes. In the XMSS world, we can't sign the same kind of message twice with the same key
